'''Adden''' was the leader of a group of brigands that was in [[Cairhien]].

==Appearance==
He was a handsome man who was large and had fair hair.

==Activities==
When [[Egwene al'Vere]], [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] and [[Elayne Trakand]] were traveling from [[Tar Valon]] to [[Tear]], they were ambushed by a group of brigands. One of Adden's men saw their [[Great Serpent ring]]s and captured them. He believed that he could get a good price for [[Aes Sedai]] if one had the stomach to deal with the right kind of buyer, a [[Myrddraal]]. He died with a spear through him when a group of [[Aiel]], including [[Aviendha]], [[Dailin (maiden)|Dailin]] and [[Rhuarc]], saved the three women.{{ref/book|3|39}}
